definitions.explanation: The smallest structural and functional unit of living organisms, typically microscopic and consisting of cytoplasm and a nucleus enclosed in a membrane.

examples.japanese: {人間|にんげん}の{体|からだ}は{約|やく}37{兆|ちょう}の{細胞|さいぼう}からできている。
examples.english: The human body is made up of approximately 37 trillion cells.

examples.japanese: {顕微鏡|けんびきょう}で{細胞|さいぼう}を{観察|かんさつ}した。
examples.english: I observed cells under a microscope.

examples.japanese: がん{細胞|さいぼう}が{異常|いじょう}に{増殖|ぞうしょく}する。

notes:
{細胞|さいぼう} refers to biological cells. {細|さい} means 'small/fine' and {胞|ぼう} means 'sac/cell.'

TYPES OF CELLS:
- {赤血球|せっけっきゅう}: red blood cell
- {白血球|はっけっきゅう}: white blood cell
- {神経|しんけい}{細胞|さいぼう}: nerve cell
- {幹|かん}{細胞|さいぼう}: stem cell
- がん{細胞|さいぼう}: cancer cell

CELL BIOLOGY:
- {細胞|さいぼう}{分裂|ぶんれつ}: cell division
- {細胞膜|さいぼうまく}: cell membrane
- {細胞核|さいぼうかく}: cell nucleus
- {細胞|さいぼう}{壁|へき}: cell wall (in plants)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {細胞|さいぼう}レベルで: at the cellular level
- {細胞|さいぼう}が{活性化|かっせいか}する: cells become active
